accessions: GSE110507 (not named in the paper; rat VDR-OE RNA-seq, S2.7.p1)
GSE47881 (human 20-wk RET microarray, S2.8.p1; separate series, not this case)
assay: rat tibialis anterior RNA-seq (Illumina HiSeq 4000, 75 bp PE), Rsubread featureCounts
primary_estimand: Effect of in vivo electrotransfer VDR overexpression (pCAGGS-mVDR, right TA) vs contralateral empty-vector control (left TA) on rat TA gene expression, paired within animal, n = 7 (S2.7.p1, FIG1, FIG5). No exercise intervention in the rat experiment.
planned_contrasts: VDR-OE vs contralateral empty-vector control, paired by animal (S3.2.p1; paper: 3,330 genes at P < 0.05)
exercise_component: Human 20-week resistance exercise training (pre vs post) is analysed only as VDR mRNA correlations with lean-mass/1-RM change, using GSE47881 (S2.8.p1, S3.4.p1, FIG7); not in GSE110507.
paper_method: edgeR: CPM filter at a count of 10, TMM, glmFit with design accounting for animal pairing (S2.7.p1)
paper_results: 3,330 genes P < 0.05; 310 gene-sets FDR < 5%, ECM up, tRNA aminoacylation/mTOR down (S3.2.p1)
